narrative:
Harrison County has 9,438 registered voters, with 57.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 24.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 18.4%, a clear Republican lean of 6.1 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 33.2% of registrants.
